doc.name: B — editorial frames, greenhouse humidity (fog), still, meditative stillness

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: greenhouse humidity (fog)
Register: still, meditative stillness
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 4
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in a greenhouse humidity (fog), shot in a register of still, meditative stillness.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a greenhouse humidity (fog), shot in a register of still, meditative stillness.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a two-shot of both leads sharing the frame, featuring both leads, medium two-shot.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 24-70mm zoom at the long end at f/5.6, using leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners, at a high-angle looking down.

LIGHT. Hard side light with 80 percent of the frame falling into shadow. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a greenhouse humidity (fog), shot in a register of still, meditative stillness.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a back-of-head frame of the female lead facing away into the scene, featuring the female lead from behind.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/2, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right, at a macro insert.

LIGHT. Split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a greenhouse humidity (fog), shot in a register of still, meditative stillness.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a mirror or reflection frame carrying both leads, featuring both leads via a reflective surface.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/11, using deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon, at a medium close-up.

LIGHT. A large overhead octabox with a black flag killing the floor bounce. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a greenhouse humidity (fog), shot in a register of still, meditative stillness.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a tight profile frame with the second lead soft in the background, featuring one lead sharp, one soft.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm at f/16, using leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners, at a low-angle hero frame.

LIGHT. A large overhead octabox with a black flag killing the floor bounce. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.
